content:
Ready for a full Class 2 Maths Olympiad rehearsal? A real IMO or SOF paper mixes every chapter — numbers, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, geometry, measurement, data handling and reasoning — in one 30-question set. This free test gives a 10-question taste, and the practice-papers e-book gives you 30 complete Maths Olympiad Class 2 sample papers with answers.

What a Class 2 IMO sample paper looks like

  • 30 questions in one paper, balanced across all 10 chapters
  • A mix of number work, tables, fractions, shapes, measurement, data and reasoning
  • An answer key and step-by-step solution for every question
  • Graded intermediate to hard, just like the real SOF Olympiad

How to use Class 2 Olympiad practice papers

  • Sit one paper in a quiet 30–40 minute slot, no help
  • Mark it with the answer key, then read the solution for every wrong one
  • Note which chapter the mistakes cluster in and revise that chapter
  • Repeat weekly — steady practice beats last-minute cramming

Take the free mixed test

The 10 questions below are pulled from across the syllabus. The full 30 Practice Papers e-book has 900 questions — 30 papers of 30 — each fully solved: the best Maths Olympiad class 2 question papers PDF for exam practice.

quiz.intro: Ten questions from across the syllabus. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.
quiz.about: IMO Maths Olympiad Class 2: all chapters

questions.q: Veer starts at 578 and counts on 7 tens. Which number does Veer reach?

questions.explanation: Add two at a time: 24 + 39 = 63, then 63 + 28 = 91.
The ones need a borrow: take 1 ten from 84. Then 84 − 29 = 55.
Think of the table: 8 × 5 = 40, so 40 ÷ 8 = 5. The missing number is 8.

questions.q: Zoya painted 1/3 of a fence. What fraction of the fence is not painted yet?
questions.explanation: The fence has 3 equal parts in all: 3/3 - 1/3 = 2/3 is not painted.

questions.q: How many more faces than edges does a cylinder have?
questions.explanation: A cylinder has 3 faces and 2 edges: 3 - 2 = 1.

questions.q: Zoya has a lace 100 cm long. She cuts off 55 cm to make a frock. How much lace is left?
questions.explanation: Take away the cut piece: 100 cm - 55 cm = 45 cm of lace is left.

questions.q: The table shows fish in tanks: Tank A 13, Tank B 22, Tank C 16, Tank D 12. What is the total shown by the whole table?
Clean is to dirty as Loud is to ___? (Think of opposites.)
questions.explanation: Dirty is the opposite of clean, and quiet is the opposite of loud.
